headline: Clinton order adds more members to the White House Commission on Complementary and Alternative Medicine Policy.
what_it_does: This order changes an earlier order, Executive Order 13147, which created a White House commission to study policy on complementary and alternative medicine. It increases the number of people who can serve on that commission. The title does not say how many members were added or who they would be.

who_it_affects.group: Members and appointees of the White House Commission on Complementary and Alternative Medicine Policy
who_it_affects.how: More people can be appointed to serve on the commission.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed September 15, 2000; the exact effective date is not stated in the source material.
